items.text: Self-reported score: mean per-gene Pearson r = 0.1255 (SD 0.0005 over 2 splits), on 1500 genes; 2000 distinct validation cells enter the gene-level tests.

Required comparators on the same training and validation cells, genes and scoring target: noise ceiling (RNA-to-RNA) 0.1686; cluster-mean baseline 0.1211, ridge 0.1357, partial least squares 0.1366, k-nearest neighbours 0.0638, gene activity 0.0343, depth only 0.0298. The plan reaches 74% of the ceiling.
Margin over the cluster-mean baseline: mean per-gene difference in r = +0.0034 (95% interval +0.0020 to +0.0052, bootstrap over cells); margin over the best simple learner (ridge, PLS, k-NN) -0.0110.

Three-way gene classification by the evaluator's rule, applied inside the development set: 261 genes cannot be judged (ceiling not above the permutation null), 1164 are not beyond the cell-type baseline, 75 are predicted beyond cell type (paired bootstrap against the cluster-mean baseline, FDR 5%; 6.1% of judgeable genes). Genes with r above the permutation null: 1051.

Training: fit 0: early_stopping after 33 epochs, converged=True (Early stopping fired after 33 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving.); fit 1: early_stopping after 34 epochs, converged=True (Early stopping fired after 34 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving.).

Validation design: split unit cell; 3-fold cross-validation; 2 seed(s); scored against an independent half of each validation cell's reads (unsmoothed, same as the evaluator). Early stopping used a separate split carved from the training cells.
Scale of this run: pilot; 2 of the 6 declared train/validation splits were run (3000 development cells, 1500 genes; the full problem has 7288 cells and 11282 genes).
Cost: 173 s of model fitting on 32 CPU cores (cpu); declared budget for the full run 48.0 min, needs GPU: False.

Compliance checks: inputs_from_view passed; no_label_inputs passed; scoring_target_allowed passed; correct_split_unit passed; no_forbidden_inputs passed; components_executable passed; within_budget passed.

Fields of the plan the executor has no implementation for (its defaults were used; some of these are descriptive text rather than settings): ['training.cell_weighting', 'training.convergence_audit', 'training.exposure_handling', 'training.internal_val_fraction'].
